outlier_flag.9992/003: run 9992/003 (seed 3, third replicate, seed3-triple-prime) is an outlier on the central-cell activity axis (this reading, sections 3a/6/4) but NOT on held-out loss (results/night5/night_report_checkpoints.csv). Whoever opens the activity profiles next must NOT silently pool it as "a twin like the others" and must NOT silently drop it -- both choices must be stated before the profiles are opened.
